export.how: timm.create_model(repo, pretrained=True, num_classes=0).eval(); torch.onnx.export opset 17, input 1x3x224x224, BatchNorm folded into the convolutions; the classifier is removed: the file emits the 1280-value pooled embedding

license.notice: MobileNetV4-conv-small weights from timm (Ross Wightman, Hugging Face), Apache-2.0 per the model card read 2026-11-03; trained on ImageNet-1k, whose own terms are research-oriented — the same caveat IU-01 recorded for every ImageNet trunk. The file is a format conversion of those weights with the classifier removed.
